decisions.title: Seed 1201 earns two more frozen seeds
decisions.summary: Seed 1201 earned the two additional frozen seeds, which have now completed. Both remaining families survived to 6,000, late births and deaths continued, and each fixed-camera comparison showed changed occupied regions and gaps.

decisions.title: Seed 1202 passes the longevity screen
decisions.summary: Alive at 6000 with two families, continuing late births/deaths, low ceiling occupancy and concrete spatial changes in all three late comparisons. This screen stops at 6000.
